data_sources: RBI Department of Payment and Settlement Systems reports 2026

fraud_statistics.target_demographics: Gig workers disproportionately affected due to daily UPI transactions and lower financial literacy

rule_1.name: NEVER_ASK_FOR_PIN_OR_OTP
rule_1.description: System must NEVER ask user for UPI PIN or OTP under any circumstances
rule_1.violation_response: If any message from ANY source contains 'enter your PIN' or 'share your OTP', surface IMMEDIATE fraud alert
rule_1.implementation: String matching + LLM classification to detect PIN/OTP requests in ANY context

rule_2.name: ALWAYS_WARN_ABOUT_PIN_OTP_REQUESTS
rule_2.description: If fraud pattern involves someone asking for PIN/OTP, explicitly warn user to NEVER share
rule_2.warning_template: ⚠️ FRAUD ALERT: Never share your UPI PIN or OTP with anyone. No bank, government agency, or platform will ever ask for your PIN.

fake_kyc_call.name: Fake KYC Verification Call
fake_kyc_call.description: Fraudster poses as bank/UPI provider claiming KYC will expire or is incomplete
common_phrases: Your UPI account will be blocked
Click this link to update KYC
detection_signals: Link sent via SMS/WhatsApp (not official app)
Request to enter OTP or PIN
fake_kyc_call.target_group: All UPI users, especially gig workers who receive frequent platform payouts
fake_kyc_call.action_on_detection: Block transaction, alert user with explanation, log incident
fake_kyc_call.user_warning: Banks NEVER ask you to verify KYC via links sent in SMS. Visit official website or branch only.

fake_qr_overlay.name: Fake QR Code Overlay at Merchant
fake_qr_overlay.description: Physical QR code sticker placed over legitimate merchant QR at petrol pumps, food stalls, shops
detection_signals: Payment to new/unknown counterparty at location user frequently visits
Merchant name mismatch (e.g., paying 'RAJESH KUMAR' at 'HP Petrol Pump')
First-time counterparty at known merchant category (fuel, food)
Transaction amount within normal range but counterparty suspicious
fake_qr_overlay.target_group: Gig workers who frequently refuel or eat at roadside stalls
fake_qr_overlay.action_on_detection: Flag transaction for user review BEFORE payment (pre-transaction alert)
fake_qr_overlay.user_warning: Check merchant name carefully before paying. If name looks wrong, ask merchant to confirm QR code. Physical QR stickers can be fake.

task_based_job_scam.name: Task-Based Job Scam (Advance Fee Fraud)
task_based_job_scam.description: Fraudster offers fake job requiring upfront 'registration fee' or 'security deposit' with promise of high returns
common_phrases: Send ₹500 registration fee to activate account
detection_signals: Debit transaction with description containing 'registration', 'activation', 'security deposit', 'job fee'
User's recent transaction history shows platform payout (suggesting they are looking for additional income)
task_based_job_scam.target_group: Gig workers seeking additional income sources
task_based_job_scam.action_on_detection: Block transaction if possible, alert user BEFORE completing payment
task_based_job_scam.user_warning: Legitimate jobs NEVER ask for upfront payment. If someone asks you to pay to get a job, it is a scam.

fake_refund_request.name: Fake Refund/Wrong Payment Scam
fake_refund_request.description: Fraudster claims they accidentally sent money to user and requests return via UPI collect or direct transfer
common_phrases: I sent you money by mistake
My child sent you money by mistake
detection_signals: Followed by UPI collect request or message requesting return
Collect request amount may be HIGHER than credited amount (classic scam)

transaction_pattern.step_1: User receives credit from unknown person
transaction_pattern.step_2: Within minutes/hours, receive collect request or message asking for return
transaction_pattern.step_3: Collect amount may exceed credited amount

fake_refund_request.target_group: All UPI users, especially those who receive frequent payouts (confusion factor)
fake_refund_request.action_on_detection: Alert user BEFORE accepting collect request; verify credit actually exists; warn about amount mismatch
fake_refund_request.user_warning: If someone claims they sent you money by mistake, check your bank statement first. Never return money via UPI collect. Contact your bank if unsure.

collect_request_new_counterparty_large.name: UPI Collect Request from New Counterparty - Large Amount
collect_request_new_counterparty_large.description: User receives UPI collect request from unknown/new counterparty for large amount
detection_signals: No recent credit from this counterparty (rules out legitimate refund)
collect_request_new_counterparty_large.action_on_detection: Alert user before accepting; show counterparty name/number; ask for confirmation
collect_request_new_counterparty_large.user_warning: You received a payment request from someone you haven't paid before. Verify the person and reason before accepting.

rapid_micro_debits.name: Rapid Micro-Debits (Card Testing / Account Probing)
rapid_micro_debits.description: Multiple small debits in short time window to same or multiple counterparties - often precursor to larger fraud
detection_signals: Same counterparty OR multiple new counterparties
No corresponding credits (rules out split payments to friends)

transaction_pattern.purpose: Testing if card/UPI is active before attempting large fraud

rapid_micro_debits.action_on_detection: Block subsequent transactions temporarily; alert user; recommend changing UPI PIN
rapid_micro_debits.user_warning: We detected multiple small debits from your account in quick succession. This may indicate your UPI PIN is compromised. Change your PIN immediately.

large_atypical_debit.name: Large Atypical Debit
large_atypical_debit.description: Single debit significantly larger than user's historical pattern
large_atypical_debit.target_group: All users, especially those with consistent spending patterns
large_atypical_debit.action_on_detection: Flag for user review; send notification asking for confirmation
large_atypical_debit.user_warning: This transaction is much larger than your usual spending. If you didn't make this payment, contact your bank immediately.

duplicate_transaction.name: Duplicate Transaction
duplicate_transaction.description: Exact same amount to same counterparty within short time window - may indicate technical glitch or fraud
duplicate_transaction.action_on_detection: Alert user about duplicate; may be accidental double-click
duplicate_transaction.user_warning: You just made the same payment twice. If this was a mistake, contact the recipient or your bank for refund.

unauthorized_recurring_payment.name: Unauthorized Auto-Debit / Recurring Payment
unauthorized_recurring_payment.description: Recurring debit that user did not authorize or forgot about
detection_signals: User has not interacted with service recently
unauthorized_recurring_payment.target_group: All users with multiple subscription services
unauthorized_recurring_payment.action_on_detection: Notify user of recurring charge; provide option to review/cancel mandates
unauthorized_recurring_payment.user_warning: You have a recurring payment active. If you don't recognize it, cancel the auto-debit mandate in your bank app.

anomaly_detection_features.description: Features to compute for ML-based anomaly detection (complement to rule-based patterns)

features.name: counterparty_frequency
features.formula: count(transactions with same counterparty in last 90 days)

features.name: time_of_day_unusual
features.formula: transaction hour outside user's normal pattern (e.g., 2 AM for user who never transacts late)

features.name: category_mismatch
features.interpretation: E.g., 'jewelry' for user who only spends on fuel/food

features.name: balance_drop_percentage
features.interpretation: >0.50 (50% balance drop in one transaction) is high risk

rbi_registered_lender_whitelist.source: RBI Master List of Regulated Entities (NBFCs, Banks, Payment Banks)
rbi_registered_lender_whitelist.usage: If transaction is to/from entity claiming to be lender, verify against RBI list
common_fake_lenders: Instant loan apps with Chinese names
Apps asking for unrestricted phone access
Lenders charging >36% APR (cap per RBI norms)
Apps without RBI registration number visible

ground_truth_labels.description: Ground truth labels in synthetic transactions.csv for evaluation
ground_truth_labels.evaluation_metric: Recall > 0.85 (missing fraud is worse than false positive)

fraud_detected_high.title: ⚠️ FRAUD ALERT
fraud_detected_high.message_template: This transaction matches the '{pattern_name}' fraud pattern. {specific_warning}
fraud_detected_high.action_required: Transaction blocked. Review details before proceeding.

fraud_detected_medium.title: ⚠️ Suspicious Activity
fraud_detected_medium.message_template: This transaction looks unusual: {reason}. Please confirm you authorized this.

fraud_detected_low.title: ℹ️ Transaction Notice
fraud_detected_low.action_required: No action needed unless you didn't make this payment.

pin_otp_warning.title: 🚨 CRITICAL SECURITY WARNING
pin_otp_warning.message: NEVER share your UPI PIN or OTP with anyone. No bank, government agency, UPI app, or employer will EVER ask for your PIN. If someone asks, it is 100% a scam. Hang up immediately and report to cyber cell.
